t2.thesis: The quarter is already pre-announced above the high end, so the entire print is the first FY2027 guide - delivered by an interim CFO off a low-margin, working-capital-hungry memory upcycle while the AI-infrastructure segment the multiple is paid for is flat - into a stock that has risen 11.6% in five sessions with a 19.5% implied move.
reasons: No surprise left in the quarter itself: on 2026-07-07 management guided FY26 net sales +22% +/-2% and non-GAAP EPS $2.60 +/-$0.05 and said both would land above the high end of the prior range. Against FY25 net sales of $1,368.8M and Q1-Q3 FY26 of $1,164.8M that implies FQ4 net sales of about $505M (+49% y/y) and implied FQ4 non-GAAP EPS of roughly $0.75 - below Q3-26's $0.84 - versus consensus $0.772 (7 analysts, $0.75-$0.80). Consensus sits at the upper half of the company's own implied range, so the bar is not walked down (LR19 reversed). All news content is therefore the initial FY2027 outlook, which is unguided and unpriced.

Quality of the growth is poor and company-stated. Q3-26 non-GAAP gross margin was 28.1% versus 31.7% a year earlier (-360bp) even as net sales rose 48%: Integrated Memory grew 111% y/y to $275.1M while Advanced Computing - the AI Factory Platform the valuation rests on - grew 3.8% to $137.6M. The 10-Q says plainly that Integrated Memory 'has gross margins which are lower than the Company average' and that growing it faster than the Company 'may negatively impact total Company gross margins', and that the AI-infrastructure shift away from hyperscalers 'may negatively impact our net sales during the transition'. Raising the FY26 revenue-growth guide by 10 points bought only 50bp of gross margin (26.0% -> 26.5%).

Cash did not follow the record earnings. At 2026-05-29 accounts receivable were $702.98M versus $307.90M at FY25 year-end (+128%) and inventories $498.32M versus $255.18M (+95%), against revenue up 48%; cash fell to $440.30M from $453.75M. AR is about 134 days of Q3 sales. The $750M 0.00% convertible issued 2026-07-17 (conversion price $116.70) funded $295.5M of old-note repurchases, a $100M revolver repayment, $49.1M of capped calls and working capital - a financing need, not a war chest. A balance sheet like this is what forces a cautious first annual guide.

The person giving that guide is an interim CFO. Nate Olmstead left on 2026-07-08; Aaron Johnson has been Interim CFO since 2026-07-09 and the permanent search was still running as of the last filing before the snapshot. An interim CFO setting a company's first full-year outlook, on a cyclical commodity tailwind, with Penguin Edge winding down by the end of FY26 as a stated FY27 comparability headwind, guides low.

The tested factors that best fit our one-open-to-next-open window also lean down: +11.6% in the last five sessions into the entry open, all of it in a single day (A_ret_5d = A_max_daily_ret_21d = 0.116), which is the So & Wang pre-print pressure/reversal setup (LR10) and the Bali MAX pattern (LR11), on a stock up 123% over 12 months (LR01). The honest offset is the option market, which leans the other way: ATM call IV exceeds put IV by 9.0 vol points and the $60 call is about $0.32 (0.52% of spot) rich to put-call parity despite 19.7% short interest making borrow expensive - a genuine Cremers-Weinbaum/Jin-Livnat-Zhang positive (LR12), reinforced by call-heavy open interest and past announcement volume of 6.1x (LR02). That offset is why this is 0.45 and not lower.
t2.deciding_variable: The initial FY2027 outlook given on the 2026-10-06 call - specifically the gross-margin line inside it and whether the Advanced Computing / AI-infrastructure segment is guided to reaccelerate, rather than the FQ4 revenue and EPS numbers, which management has already pre-announced above the high end.

t2.moved_from_prior: Prior 0.55. Down for the five-session run-up into the entry (LR10/LR11, the closest-fitting factors to this window), the extreme 12-month winner (LR01), the mix/working-capital quality of the growth, and an FY2027 guide that is the whole print and is being set by an interim CFO off a memory-price peak with consensus already at the top of the company's implied FQ4 range. Up for the parity-verified call richness (LR12) and high past announcement volume (LR02). The fundamental judgements were deliberately halved in weight because nothing in this experiment has yet shown that fundamental quality predicts direction over a one-open-to-next-open window, and because the 19.5% implied move means most of the probability mass is 'big move, unknown sign'. Net 0.45.

data_gaps: No FQ3 FY2026 earnings-call transcript was read. No Alpha Vantage key is present in this environment, and the web transcript pages available are live pages whose update time cannot be verified against captured_et, so under D004 none was used. Management's qualitative tone on FY2027 and on DRAM contract-pricing duration is therefore unknown to this decision.

The implied FQ4 non-GAAP EPS of about $0.75 is approximate: quarterly EPS does not sum to the annual figure while the diluted share count is rising (FY26 guided at 56M non-GAAP / 59M GAAP against a materially lower Q1-Q3 base). Treat it as a range, not a figure.
E_last4_prints surprise percentages come from a vendor whose EPS basis is not pinned (STATE #2), so the beat history is directionally right but not basis-verified.
